description: This source file implements the HTTP/2 protocol layer for lighttpd, including frame parsing, stream management, HPACK header compression, and connection state handling.

classes.name: request_st
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including HTTP/2-specific state.

classes.name: connection
classes.description: Represents a server connection, including request state and protocol-specific data.

classes.name: h2con
classes.description: Internal structure managing HTTP/2 connection state, streams, and settings.

methods.name: __attribute_returns_nonnull__ request_st * h2_init_stream(request_st * const h2r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTP/2 stream request context.

methods.name: void h2_recv_settings(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Handles reception and processing of HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames.

methods.name: void h2_recv_rst_stream(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Processes RST_STREAM frames to reset or close specific streams.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ void h2_recv_priority(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Processes PRIORITY frames to update stream priorities.

methods.name: void h2_recv_window_update(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Handles WINDOW_UPDATE frames to adjust flow control windows.

methods.name: void h2_send_settings_ack(connection * const con)
methods.description: Sends an ACK in response to a SETTINGS frame received from the client.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void h2_send_rst_stream(request_st * const r,connection * const con,const request_h2error_t e)
methods.description: Sends RST_STREAM frame to reset a stream with an error.

methods.name: void h2_send_goaway(connection * const con,const request_h2error_t e)
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY frame to initiate graceful shutdown or signal protocol errors.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void h2_send_goaway_e(connection * const con,const request_h2error_t e)
methods.description: Sends a GOAWAY with specific error code.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void h2_send_rst_stream_id(uint32_t h2id,connection * const con,const request_h2error_t e)
methods.description: Constructs and sends RST_STREAM frame for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: int h2_recv_goaway(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Processes a received GOAWAY frame to handle connection shutdown.

methods.name: h2_recv_frame_cq_compact
methods.description: Compacts the chunkqueue to ensure sufficient data for frame parsing.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ uint32_t h2_recv_continuation(uint32_t n,uint32_t clen,const off_t cqlen,chunkqueue * const cq,connection * const con)
methods.description: Handles the reception of CONTINUATION frames to assemble header blocks.

methods.name: int h2_recv_data(connection * const con,const uint8_t * const s,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Processes DATA frames within the HTTP/2 connection, including flow control and stream state updates.

methods.name: handler_t h2_recv_reqbody(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles incoming request body data over HTTP/2 streams.
